description: This file defines a class 'Location' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling location filter fields in reporting. It extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable, providing methods to add location-based conditions to database queries and to convert location IDs to their label representations.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a location filter field used in reporting, allowing filtering by location IDs with specific handling for special values like '-1'. Provides methods to modify query builders and convert location IDs to label data.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds location filtering conditions to the query builder based on the operator and X value, handling 'select all', 'select by country', and specific location selections.

methods.name: getLocationIds
methods.description: Returns an array of location IDs parsed from the X value.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in query contexts, here ['location'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the location ID(s) specified in X to an array with 'id' and 'label' for display purposes by querying the location service.
